title: Major Glow High Shine Nourishing Body Oil

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Skin Barrier✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Best for Dry Skin✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Floral Scent
What it is: A light body oil mist for nourished, glowing skin with moisturizing meadowfoam seed extract, protective antioxidants, and a barrier renewal complex.

Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Meadowfoam Seed Extract: For a cushiony, serum-like feel and deeply penetrating moisture.
- Plant-Derived Super-Antioxidant Blend: With rosemary, rice bran, sunflower, and tocopherol to protect the skin.
- Barrier Renewal Complex: For long-term moisture barrier improvement
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Use daily.

-For best results, massage generously into dry skin for a hydrating, high-shine glow.

Ingredients+
Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Mineral Oil (Paraffinum Liquidum/ Huile minérale), Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Propylene Glycol Dibenzoate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Isopropyl Myristate, Fragrance (Parfum), Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract, Brassica Campestris (Rapeseed) Seed Oil, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract, Emblica Officinalis Fruit Extract, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Theobroma Grandiflorum Seed Butter, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Extract, Euterpe Oleracea Fruit Oil, Phytosterols, Phospholipids, Linoleic Acid, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Benzyl Salicylate, Citral, Coumarin, Limonene, Linalool.
